cleaning_and_units: Keep raw category; separate paved/unspecified-paved from explicit material. Split semicolons into a set; never choose one material silently.
meaning: Reported material, not smoothness or pushability.
missing_value_policy: Unknown as its own class; multi-material separate.
limitations: Materials do not encode condition; broad paved tag is not specific.
recommended_expression: Categorical independent layer; NOT an ordered difficulty scale

cleaning_and_units: Use documented ordered categories excellent through impassable; preserve raw and review values.
meaning: Reported surface condition, only where tagged.
limitations: Extremely sparse and subjective; no interpolation across neighbors.
recommended_expression: Ordered classes with explicit unknown layer

cleaning_and_units: Parse bare numbers as metres; convert cm/mm/ft and feet-inches (9' = 2.7432 m). Preserve bounds, ranges and provenance; do not average ranges.
meaning: Reported way width; distinguish clear usable width from full carriageway width.
node_spatial_or_network_requirements: Node bottleneck joins; distinguish sidewalk-side width tags
limitations: Two records in Brooklyn and none in selected Jersey City; many widths may be roadway widths.
recommended_expression: Continuous colour only for measured comparable widths; unknown separate

cleaning_and_units: Keep up/down directional labels as ordinal direction only; percent numeric retained signed relative to original OSM node order. Degrees: 100*tan(degrees). Derive abs(percent) in separate field; retain original direction through clipping/reversal.
meaning: Signed grade and separate magnitude; up/down do not measure steepness.
missing_value_policy: Unknown magnitude for up/down; never turn these into 0%.
node_spatial_or_network_requirements: Future vertical data + original way orientation; validate bridges separately
limitations: Current numeric selected inclines are only four 0% records in Brooklyn; terrain DEM can misrepresent decks and ramps.
recommended_expression: Continuous signed/magnitude scale only for numeric values; up/down independent symbols

cleaning_and_units: Mark only highway=steps as reported steps; retain step_count, handrail, ramp and crossing tags separately.
meaning: Location of mapped stairs and crossings; not proof other paths are step-free.
missing_value_policy: No steps tag means not recorded as steps, not certified absence.
node_spatial_or_network_requirements: Join referenced OSM crossing/kerb/barrier nodes; network continuity review
limitations: Need explicit node-level obstacles, curb heights, ramp continuity and access checks.
recommended_expression: Steps independent line layer; crossings/kerbs point symbols

cleaning_and_units: Retain foot and access separately; include conditional/directional tags and hours. Keep explicit allow, restricted, conditional/review and unconfirmed evidence states; do not modify current map selection.
meaning: Tagged permission evidence, not current public opening or stroller suitability.
missing_value_policy: Missing stays unconfirmed; no positive inference from proximity to water.
node_spatial_or_network_requirements: Node gates and opening hours may restrict paths
limitations: Selection has already filtered restrictions and is biased toward allowed/unknown paths.
recommended_expression: Independent categorical overlay; no continuous friendliness score

cleaning_and_units: Keep yes/no/limited as stated; do not transform into stroller_friendly.
node_spatial_or_network_requirements: Node curbs, ramps and bottlenecks; physical inspection
limitations: Eight selected Jersey City records and zero in Brooklyn; wheelchair=yes is not a stroller guarantee.

cleaning_and_units: Keep bicycle permission (including dismount) and segregated yes/no independently; do not treat missing as no bikes.
node_spatial_or_network_requirements: None for tags; intersection context optional
limitations: Sparse separation data; permissions are not observed cyclist volume or conflict risk.

cleaning_and_units: Keep yes/no; scheduled or nonstandard values separate. Retain check_date:lit where present.
meaning: Reported lighting provision, not illumination quality at a given time.
node_spatial_or_network_requirements: Optional lamp-node spatial join; not inference of path lighting
limitations: No measured illuminance or guarantee of operation.

cleaning_and_units: Keep yes/no and arcade/colonnade separately; intersect verified shelter or roof polygons only as additional evidence.
meaning: Mapped overhead cover, distinct from shade or rain protection quality.
node_spatial_or_network_requirements: Spatial join roof/shelter; inspect vertical layer and actual covered walkway
limitations: Roof geometry alone may cover a building interior, not a public path; not tree shade.
recommended_expression: Independent cover layer; points for shelters

cleaning_and_units: Use a dedicated opening_hours parser with local timezone/calendar; distinguish 24/7, off, schedules, seasonal and conditional restrictions.
node_spatial_or_network_requirements: Gate/park/facility hours joins only with explicit membership evidence
limitations: No selected ways have this tag; node/facility hours may exist.
recommended_expression: Independent categorical/time filter, not a score

cleaning_and_units: Recover amenities from raw XML, deduplicate by OSM type+ID, retain access/hours. Compare Day 01 candidates only after documented identity review. Project to UTM; use point/entrance-to-line distance.
meaning: Straight-line distance to reported amenity; NOT walking distance or travel time.
missing_value_policy: Unknown where inventory incomplete or no valid entrance; distinguish no cached match.
node_spatial_or_network_requirements: Metric spatial nearest-neighbor join; verified entrances
limitations: Water, fences and level differences can make nearest facility unreachable; do not count overlapping sources twice.
recommended_expression: Continuous distance scale + facility point layer

cleaning_and_units: Build a validated pedestrian graph with true shared nodes, levels, access, steps and barriers; snap verified entrances only within stated tolerance; shortest traversable path length.
meaning: Actual modelled walking-network distance, not time.
missing_value_policy: No route differs from missing graph/entrance; do not assign infinite distance automatically.

limitations: Current way/multipart files are not a routing graph; geometric crossings do not guarantee connectivity.

cleaning_and_units: Recover tree points/tree_rows and park/woodland polygons as separate features; deduplicate IDs. Label counts or proximity as tree/green context only.
meaning: Mapped vegetation context; not actual canopy or time-dependent shade.
missing_value_policy: Unknown coverage; no trees cached is not treeless.
node_spatial_or_network_requirements: Spatial joins; actual shade needs canopy height, buildings, solar position, date/time
limitations: OSM tree mapping uneven; park landcover is not a shade measurement.
recommended_expression: Tree point symbols and separate green/canopy layers

cleaning_and_units: Publish separate observed/missing indicators per field; length-weight each attribute independently; no composite quality or suitability score.

missing_value_policy: Unknown shown explicitly, not worst-value substitution.
